label: Convert PDF to Fountain
description: Converts a screenplay PDF to Fountain format using spatial text analysis. Detects scene headings, character names, dialogue, action, transitions, and parentheticals from their x-position on the page.

pdfPath.description: Absolute path to the PDF file to convert

outputPath.description: Path to save the .fountain file. Defaults to same name as PDF with .fountain extension
Path where the .fountain file was saved

metadata.description: Extracted metadata: title, author, pages, scenes, characters
